snippet.title: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Call to Arms: Panzer Elite delivers the most immersive and tactically rich tank platoon simulation of World War II. Take direct control of up to five tanks, switching between them in real time as you battle across the war-torn countryside of Normandy. Each battlefield is alive – every shell, crater, and destroyed building reshapes the combat landscape, demanding quick thinking and strategic adaptation.

Wishlist on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343070/Call_to_Arms_Panzer_Elite/
